g.text: Facts: three layers, most specific first
owned by the consumer project; its own failure signatures
machine-level facts on the private void-mirror branch ($SILKOPS_FACTS_OVERLAY)
generic GitLab, Docker and runner behaviour; never names a consumer
classify-failure.py reads all three, in that order
searched in that order; the first matching pattern wins, so a repo fact overrides core
transient + retry_safe → one retry; permanent → report; unknown → never retried
A fact belongs with the project that owns its signature. Add it to the repo file, not to core.
